metadata.scope: Synthetic CPU vector-storage/search comparison; no semantic/model-quality claims
limitations: Clustered synthetic vectors and repetitive text; no real embedding relevance or answer accuracy measured.
Single client and one PC; three warm passes repeat 32 independent query vectors per corpus.
HTTP and PostgreSQL protocols, storage schemas and preparation boundaries differ.
Initial pass is not a cold OS/disk-cache measurement.
Filtered HNSW-labelled configurations use exact filter/index/sort plans.
Memory includes page cache/setup and cumulative container history; PostgreSQL WAL is cluster-wide.
VectorNext checkpoints failed at both sizes due to the 64 MiB snapshot frame limit; successful journal recovery does not establish checkpoint support.
Offline export calls checkpoint and is therefore also blocked at these states; inferred from code, no export command tested here.
Normal application and an unrelated service remained running; not a dedicated idle machine.
The stats endpoint does not compute a digest; its empty SHA256 field is not verification. Use verified_digest and recovery.digest.

attempts.outcome: 400-document load/digest passed; preparation report failed to serialize PostgreSQL Decimal WAL counter; no timed queries.
400-document timed queries completed; checkpoint rejection stopped recovery. Captures preserved.
Both sizes complete with recorded checkpoint failures and successful recovery under amendment 01.
